scores.evidence: Bar-Adon pp. 103–104, site 5 (Sarṭaba, 1938 1670): fortress 35 x 30 m, two pools to the NW, an ancient quarry SW, eight rock-cut caves 'in the slope' with no direction, an aqueduct, an enclosure at 1938 1664. No grave or tomb is mentioned and no list is said to be complete.

Bar-Adon p. 105, site 13 (T. esh-Sheikh Dhiab, 1908 1615): a modern Arab cemetery on a mound 'near' the tell, with no direction; a 45 x 45 m building SW of the tell; channel remains 20 m W of it. No grave is placed in the north sector and no list is said to be complete.
Bar-Adon p. 114, site 61 (T. es-Samrat; 19-14/11/1, 1917 1413): held area H1, so only measured content was read (a height of 6–7 m). No pool is placed and no absence statement was read.

Bar-Adon p. 122, site 98 sub-item ג (98c, 1933 1268): a fortress apparently with casemates, 40 x 60 m, west of the Qumran–Feshkha road, buildings to its south; Roman. No pool, cistern or channel is named; no absence statement.
Bar-Adon units: S6040 (site 13) and S1283 (site 5) miss C3 and S2430 (site 61, held) and S3961 (site 98c) miss C1; all four stay UNKNOWN on the missing condition after the merge.
